claims: Artemis III is currently targeted for launch in mid-2027, according to NASA.
Artemis III will be a crewed mission aimed at testing rendezvous and docking capabilities with commercial landers in low-Earth orbit.
As of April 2026, Artemis III launch date is scheduled for 2027.
Space.com reported that the Artemis III crew will launch on the SLS (Space Launch System) rocket in the Orion spacecraft.
Space.com reported that the Artemis III crew will dock with a commercial lander (such as SpaceX’s Starship) in low-Earth orbit, rather than immediately landing on the Moon.
SpaceNews and The Guardian note that the Artemis III mission revision follows concerns over technological readiness, focusing on addressing delays in the human landing system (HLS).
The actual human lunar landing has been shifted to the Artemis IV mission.
Artemis IV mission is now targeted for 2028.
